welcomeBody: Write to the people who make this app. You will get an answer here.
welcomeBodyApp: Questions, bugs or ideas: the people who make {app} read every message and reply here.
closeHint: You can close this; the reply waits here.
retrying: Not sent yet. Trying again soon.
unreachable: Can't reach the chat right now. Messages will send when it's back.
heldPaused: Not sent yet. It will send when the chat is back.
heldVerification: Not sent yet. It will send after you sign in.
failPhotoOpen: This photo can't be opened here. Try a JPEG or PNG.
failPhotoSize: This photo is too large to send.
failTooLong: This message is too long to send.
offerGone: This offer is no longer available.
offline: You're offline. Messages will send when you're back online.
rateLimited: Sending is paused for a while. Try again later.
photosCountdown: Photos can be sent again in {time}. Text still sends.
photosPaused: Photos are paused for a while. Text still sends.
blocked: You can't send messages in this chat.
paused: This chat is paused for now.
verification: Sign in to the app to message the team.
unsupported: This message needs a newer version of the app.
reviewBody: Your review helps other people find {app}.
manageBody: Change your plan, payment method or renewal.
billingBody: Update your payment method to keep your subscription.
refundBody: The store handles refunds. This opens their request page.
redeemBody: Enter your offer code to unlock it.
restoreBody: Open the app on your phone to restore what you bought.
